title: Time Stranger Kyoko
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the 30th century, Kyoko Suomi, the princess of Earth, lives among commoners and does not want the throne; the king lets her live as she pleases if she can revive her twin sister Ui, trapped in time since birth (Viz blurb). A three-volume magical-girl adventure with bodyguards, a fake engagement, gods and time manipulation; MangaUpdates lists it as cut short.
life_message: It holds up sisterly love and taking responsibility, even for a duty one first tries to avoid.
